EmbeddedWorkerOffTests.test_the_sqlite_r.note: There is no web process without PRKS_AUTH and psycopg any more: every web process serves its Library from PostgreSQL and has a jobs runtime. What stays is that PRKS_EMBEDDED_WORKER=0 starts no embedded worker thread and opens no worker pool.

EmbeddedWorkerOffTests.test_the_sqlite_r.obsolete: It called the Processing queue handlers the way the SQLite runtime did, with no admitted request context and a SQLite store, to prove they claimed none of their paths and loaded no psycopg there. That runtime is gone: every request now reaches the queue with an admitted context on PostgreSQL, where its routes, access rules and refusals are tested in tests/pg/test_http_processing.py (QueueTests, ImportAndDeleteTests, AccessTests).
